environment.linear_solver: sparse LU (scipy splu) inside the ALM active-set loop

params.units: dimensionless: lengths/R, forces/(E R^2); SI equivalent R = 10 mm, E = 100 GPa

reference: Hertz 1882 J. reine angew. Math. 92:156; Johnson 1985 Contact Mechanics 4.2 DOI:10.1017/cbo9781139171731

probe_low_load.note: contact-radius estimators break down when a/R is small enough that the patch edge falls between coarse nodes; documented as a failure mode, not gated

truncation_failure_mode.note: depth 24a is inside the truncation error: -2.90% vs -1.01% at 96a, i.e. a 1.89 pp sensitivity that fails the 1 pp band.  The first certificate draft gated 24a->96a and returned FAIL; the scope was narrowed to the accepted-depth step (48a->96a = 0.63 pp) and this row kept as the failure-mode record.  Disclosed, not silently dropped.

control.note: zero-contact branch is covered in tests/test_hertz_contact_loadcontrol.py
